description: Small explicitly labeled calibration set, curated from prior game evaluations. Update labels/reasons after real playtests; it is not automatically synced from ChatGPT.

examples.reason: Intuitive spatial action, clear impacts and sequential victories. Keep reducing ambiguity between launching and powering.
Direct finger gestures on geometric structure can be delightful; rare false negative recognition is unacceptable, and hints must guide without spoiling.
Original flow branching affords some structure; risks becoming repetitive arrow flipping without deeper constraints.
Rolling a physical die is intuitive; repeated three-roll paths create sameness. Depth must come from geometry and inference, not move count.
Beautiful mathematical transformations alone were not a satisfying strategic game.
Explaining the weights was possible but core play did not create compelling repeated decisions.
Without visible meaning for frequencies the best tactic was random lever fiddling.
Arbitrary enforcement of fully narrowing suspects before guessing felt unreasonable. Success conditions must match player intent.
Trivially short search with no deeper layered constraints; increasing dimension alone does not guarantee fun.
